title: Woman died after seizure in jail
article: A woman who died in police custody suffered a seizure shortly after being taken to jail, a coroner's inquest heard yesterday.
Candice Pete was arrested after injecting drugs in public on Jan. 5, 2006.
After her seizure, she remained unconscious until her death in hospital four days later, the inquest heard.
Coroner Owen Court and a five-person jury viewed a 10-minute video in which Pete is shown in a cell repeatedly trying to throw up into a sink.

Retired Vancouver police Sgt. Sherron Bayley, the officer in charge of the jail, testified she would have intervened if corrections officers had told her Pete was trying to throw up, presumably after ingesting drugs.
